text: well, so, the problem is this: if it is a 1x1 patch or whatever, and i open the patch panel, and make that 1x1 take up say a 1k image, its still expected in the full scale uv that this is the same size, so changing the uv size in the focus shouldnt make it that size globally
resolution: Replaced the direct master-atlas patch focus with a true local mapping workspace. Selecting a reusable image now edits a temporary UV copy; Apply + Show All triangle-rasterizes that source into the islands' original signed-atlas footprint, keeps master UV coordinates and scale untouched, and writes transparent pixels outside the selected silhouettes so neighboring islands are not painted. Added render-face identity validation and regression tests proving a 4x4 local fit remains a 2x2 master footprint. UV layout 50/50, workspace 7/7, patch 3/3, and editor bundle checks pass.
